briefing: Markets were mostly flat to slightly lower today: the NASDAQ was nearly unchanged and the S&P 500 fell 0.4%, so there was no clear signal either way. We are keeping all seven current positions and letting the automatic stop-losses and profit targets do their work. We are putting our small cash balance into one cybersecurity stock, Tenable (TENB), at medium conviction rather than spreading thin across several names.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag is the return you give up when money sits uninvested instead of working in the market. Even on quiet days, an idle cash balance can make a portfolio fall behind its benchmark over time. That is why we put our leftover cash into one strong candidate today instead of letting it sit.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「現金拖累」是指資金閒置未投入市場時所錯失的潛在回報。即使市況平淡，長期持有過多閒置現金，亦可能令組合表現落後於基準指數。因此，今日我們將餘下現金投放於一隻技術形態強勁的股份，而非讓資金閒置。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted slightly lower: the S&P 500 lost 0.4% and the NASDAQ was close to flat at -0.1%. Since big tech held up roughly level, the selling looks spread across the wider market rather than centred on growth stocks. No specific news headlines were provided today, so this reading is based only on how prices moved, and that pattern usually means investors are waiting for a clearer reason to buy or sell.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日窄幅偏軟，標普500指數微跌0.4%，納斯達克指數僅跌0.1%，大致持平。科技股表現相對抗跌，顯示沽壓較分散於大市，而非集中於增長股。由於今日未有具體新聞標題可供參考，以上分析純粹基於價格走勢；這類走勢通常代表資金觀望，等待更明確的方向訊號。

trades.reasoning: TENB has every momentum signal on our list: RSI at 63.7, which is strong without being overbought, a bullish MACD crossover with a rising histogram, and a price about 7% above its 20-day average, so it is a sensible small use of the $546 in idle cash and one of 3 open slots.
